question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed experimental Claws package and lifecycle direction as the cross-repository contract for complete new agents?
rationale: The patch adds new feature and configuration surface with lifecycle, provenance, package, registry, and compatibility implications that cannot be resolved by mechanical review.

options.title: Sponsor the RFC direction
options.body: Accept the experimental Claws scope and have the relevant product owners verify the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub landing stack before merge.

options.title: Narrow the RFC
options.body: Request a smaller initial contract that defers lifecycle or registry commitments until the core implementation proves the boundary.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the proposal open without merging until a product owner prioritizes this agent-packaging model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the RFC direction
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental Claws scope and have the relevant product owners verify the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub landing stack before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible review feedback directly addresses the product naming and MCP/package ownership boundaries at the center of this RFC.
